summary_short.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
summary_short.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable comp…

summary_short.zh: FreeMoCap 是一个开源运动捕捉系统，它通过多台普通网络摄像头实现三维人体动作追踪，让这项技术不再依赖昂贵专业设备。其核心技术在于计算机视觉算法：从不同视角的二维姿态估计中三角测量出精确的三维骨骼模型，并实时处理。用户只需搭建多摄像头阵列，就能通过 Python 流程捕获运动数据，适用于动画制作、生物力学分析或人机交互研究，为创意和技术实验提供了易用的工具。
summary_short.en: FreeMoCap is an open-source motion capture system that democratizes 3D body tracking by using multiple standard webcams instead of expensive specialized hardware. Its core innovation lies in computer vision algorithms that triangulate 2D pose estimates from different camera angl…

summary_short.zh: Claude-Code-Telegram 是一个基于 Python 的 Telegram 机器人，它让开发者能够通过手机或任何设备远程访问 Claude Code 的 AI 编程助手，解决了开发环境受地点限制的问题。该项目通过 Telegram 的消息平台实现持久化编码会话，即使切换设备也能保持项目对话的连续性，这种设计让移动端编程变得更加流畅。开发者可以将其配置为接收代码建议、调试帮助和项目管理支持，特别适合在通勤途中进行快速编码咨询或利用碎片时间推进项目，为分布式团队和移动办公场景提供了实用的 AI 辅助工具。
summary_short.en: Claude-Code-Telegram is a Python-based Telegram bot that enables developers to remotely access Claude Code's AI coding assistance from anywhere, solving the problem of being tied to specific development environments. Its technical innovation lies in maintaining persistent coding…
summary_short.es: Claude-Code-Telegram is a Python-based Telegram bot that enables developers to remotely access Claude Code's AI coding assistance from anywhere, solving the problem of being tied to specific development environments. Its technical innovation lies in maintaining persistent coding…

summary_short.zh: Open-Mercato是一个基于TypeScript的CRM/ERP基础框架，旨在通过提供模块化、可扩展的构建块来加速商业应用的开发。其技术核心在于将强大的默认配置与完全自定义能力相结合，使团队既能获得开箱即用的功能，又能根据具体需求深度定制，避免了供应商锁定问题。该框架特别适合需要快速构建研发工具、运营系统或增长平台的团队，开发者可以基于其AI支持架构创建适应业务演变的定制化解决方案，实现从原型到生产环境的平滑过渡。
summary_short.en: Open-Mercato is a TypeScript-based CRM/ERP foundation framework designed to accelerate development of business applications by providing modular, extensible building blocks. Its technical strength lies in combining strong default configurations with complete customization capabi…
summary_short.es: Open-Mercato is a TypeScript-based CRM/ERP foundation framework designed to accelerate development of business applications by providing modular, extensible building blocks. Its technical strength lies in combining strong default configurations with complete customization capabi…
